author: IS24796

title: Generating and maintaining a habit
body:
I love the app for all its features. It looks simple but there is really a lot of details like notification and reminders you can put on a particular habit. The feeling of accomplishing a habit is so satisfying and makes you feel motivated not to break the streaks.
It’s even integrated with your apple watch!

Suggestion:
1. To have the countdown timer in the lockscreen when we press the power button while the phone is still locked
2. When a countdown timer has started, make the icon as big as the screen so we can focus on looking at the timer when we look at our phone screen
3. Have the option to keep the screen always on when countdown timer has started

title: Great app
